title: Persuasive Sentence Ladder – Hello Kitty
hp: Copy it in your book or type it on screen, then expand and improve one persuasive sentence at a time.
h2: Build a persuasive sentence about Hello Kitty from Level 1 to Level 3
intro: Tap a level to reveal it, then copy the sentence into your book or into the box. Students can compare how each version becomes more convincing.

levels.label: Level 1: Opinion
levels.say: Level 1. Copy the opinion into your book or into the box.
levels.text: Hello Kitty should have her own movie.
levels.ans: Hello Kitty should have her own movie.

levels.label: Level 2: Add a reason
levels.say: Level 2. Copy the sentence, then add a reason.
levels.text: Hello Kitty should have her own movie because she is loved by millions of fans.
levels.ans: Hello Kitty should have her own movie because she is loved by millions of fans.

levels.label: Level 3: Add persuasive language
levels.say: Level 3. Copy the sentence, then add persuasive language.
levels.text: Hello Kitty should definitely have her own movie because she is loved by millions of fans around the world.
levels.ans: Hello Kitty should definitely have her own movie because she is loved by millions of fans around the world.

levels.label: Full Sentence: Fully persuasive sentence
levels.say: Copy the fully persuasive sentence into your book or into the box.
levels.text: Hello Kitty should definitely have her own movie, not just a cartoon, because she is loved by millions of fans around the world and deserves a big screen story.
levels.ans: Hello Kitty should definitely have her own movie, not just a cartoon, because she is loved by millions of fans around the world and deserves a big screen story.

bh: Challenge: Put the persuasive sentence back together
bsay: Challenge. Put the words in order to make the persuasive sentence.
bsmall: Tap the chips in order to build the fully expanded sentence.
ans: Hello Kitty should definitely have her own movie, not just a cartoon, because she is loved by millions of fans around the world and deserves a big screen story.
